AGENDA
PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.

THIS AGENDA HAS BEEN AMENDED TO INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING NOTICE:
This meeting is being held pursuant to Executive Order N-25-20 issued by California Governor Gavin Newsom on March 12, 2020 to further the State's efforts to control the spread of COVID-19 Coronavirus. Planning Commissioners will attend and participate by teleconference/virtual meeting. Members of the public may also attend by teleconference in order to observe and provide public comment during the meeting. The meeting will not be livestreamed. If you wish to participate, the following process must be followed.
• Thursday, January 14 @ 5:00 p.m. - written correspondence is due to CDPW@PVEstates.org. If you require a physical letter, it may be mailed to or dropped off at City Hall at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274.
• Tuesday, January 19 @ NOON - if you wish to present any visual aids such as a PowerPoint or photos during your public comment period, a PDF is due to CDPW@PVEstates.org.
• Tuesday, January 19 @ 6:30 p.m. - if you wish to speak during the meeting, you must email CDPW@PVEstates.org with (1) your name, (2) the project address on which you'd like to speak, and (3) the phone number and/or Zoom name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards.
The meeting will begin promptly at 6:30 p.m. so please prepare and join the meeting in advance of 6:30 p.m. You will be muted upon entry. The host will unmute you when it is your turn to speak. Each member of the public is allotted 3 minutes maximum to present.
The City thanks you for your patience and understanding as we do our best to carry on the public process given current circumstances.

MEMORANDUM
  Agenda Item #:  5
  Meeting Date: 2/16/2021

TO:  PLANNING COMMISSION

FROM:  BRIANNA RINDGE, COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DIRECTOR

SUBJECT:  PLANNING COMMISSION ACTIONS OF JANUARY 19, 2021

DATE:  FEBRUARY 16, 2021

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Present:  Wade, Lazzaro, Walker
Absent:  Criley
Also present: Acting Planning & Building Director Brianna Rindge, Planner Brenna Wengert,
  Assistant City Attorney John Cotti

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

  Speakers: None

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  M-1425-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2021-1213); Consideration of a Miscellaneous
  Application structures exceeding 42” within the setback adjacent to the street located at 905
  Via Del Monte. Lot 15, Block 1636, Tract 7330. This project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner: Amir Esfahani, 314 Tejon Pl, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

  Action: Wade moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the application (3-0 in favor; Criley
  absent) with standard conditions.

2.  M-1423-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2021-1212); Consideration of a Miscellaneous
  Application structures exceeding 42” within the setback adjacent to the street located
  at 3657 Navajo Place. Lot 4 and SW 30 ft measured on NW and SE lines of Lot 5, Block
  6104, Tract 6887. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
  1
   Applicant/Owner: Carl & Anke Campanella

  Action: Wade moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the application (3-0 in favor; Criley
  absent) with standard conditions.

3.  NC-1685-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2021-1215); Consideration of Neighborhood
  Compatibility for additions and remodel to the existing single-family residence located
  at 2204 Via Pacheco. Lot 14, Block 2205, Tract 6888. This project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Luis de Moraes, 116 South Catalina Ave Ste #102, Redondo Beach, CA 90277
  Owner: Dean Turner

  Action: Wade moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the application (3-0 in favor; Criley
  absent) with standard conditions.

OLD BUSNESS

4.  NC-1682-20/M-1421-20/G-1644-20  (RESOLUTION  NO.  PCR-2021-1214);
  Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Miscellaneous, and Grading Applications
  for a new single-family residence at 2000 Noya Place. Lot 71, Tract 30905. This project
  is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3,
  Section 15303.

  Applicant: Jeffrey A. Dahl, 1102 Main Street, Huntington Beach, CA 92648
  Owner: Nick & Carly Keefe
  Speakers: Silvia Van Dusen, Bob Van Dusen, Rita Coty, Renee Sanacore

  Action: Wade moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the application (3-0 in favor; Criley
  absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1. The project
  shall comply with the City’s municipal NPDES permit and requirements set forth in
  Municipal Code 13.08.060; 2. Runoff from watershed tributary to the boundaries of the
  proposed project shall be intercepted and conveyed through the site to the street or an
  approved drainage easement; 3. The property owner shall request a license agreement in
  order to construct the nonstandard driveway as shown on the plans; 4. The master bedroom
  chimney shall be eliminated; and 5. Vegetation shall be maintained no taller than the ridge
  elevation of the home.

NEW BUSNESS

5.  MOD-157-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2021-1216); Appeal of Minor Modification of
  NC-1660-19, G-1632-19 & M-1354-19; Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading &
  Miscellaneous Applications for a new single-family residence on a vacant lot located
  at 2321 Via Acalones. Lot 20, Tract 7330 ½ Vac alley adj on SE, Block 1638. This project
  is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3,
  Section 15303.

  2
   Applicant: Pritzkat & Johnson Architects, Inc., 306 Vista Del Mar, Ste A, Redondo Beach,
  CA 90277
  Appellant: Diana Gdowski, 2320 Via Acalones Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
  Owner: Steve & Amy Hogan
  Speakers: Anthony Poon, Debbie Steffe, Roger Yang, Mandi Leonard, Mary Kelliny,
  Perky Waterman, Richard Sullivan, Lorna Interian, Sandra Winston, Gayle Probst,
  Christina Hogan, Elizabeth Staes

  Action: Wade moved and Lazzaro seconded to deny the appeal and approve the application
  (3-0 in favor; Criley absent) with standard conditions and the following additional
  conditions: 1. The parapet area created by the change to roof pitch shall not be converted
  or utilized as a balcony without Planning Commission approval; 2. No further
  modifications or increases to the ridge height or roof lines at any point on the property are
  permitted without Planning Commission approval; and 3. The walls by the trash area
  extending to the front of the property shall not increase in height without Planning
  Commission approval.

ITEMS OF INFORMATION

6.  Administrative Approvals – Reviewed and filed.

7.  Art Jury Meeting Schedule – Reviewed and filed.

ACTION MINUTES

8.  Action Minutes from the meeting of December 15, 2020.

  Action: Lazzaro moved and Wade seconded to approve (3-0 in favor; Criley absent).

Adjourned at 10:23 P.M. to the February 16, 2021 meeting.
